work.title: Software Development Intern
bullets: Built an event-driven feedback loop that replays resolved oncall tickets through **3** service AI agents, grades each investigation against the human resolver's fix on a **4-dimension** rubric, and proposes edits to the agent spec files that misled them, using **Kotlin** on **AWS Lambda**, **Bedrock**, **S3**, and **TypeScript CDK**.
Surfaced defects in production service agents, improved root-cause accuracy on unseen tickets to **78%** and cut confidently-wrong diagnoses by **~50%**.

Drove ungrounded model output to **zero** with 8 typed validation checks (**105 Kotest** unit tests), requiring every proposed edit to quote a line from its target file and cite verified ticket evidence.
Wrote **277** tests across unit, infrastructure, authorization, and end-to-end layers with test code exceeding production code, including **146** cases covering a fail-closed authorization hook.

work.title: AI Engineering Intern
bullets: Reduced manual lookup time by **40%** and cut query latency to **under 3 seconds** by building an agentic **Retrieval Augmented Generation** system that indexed **10,000+** corporate documents using **Pydantic AI**.

Designed/deployed a production-ready internal chatbot using Model Context Protocol (**MCP**) and **Pydantic AI**, streamlining company workflows by automating tasks such as company database search and policy navigation.

projects.name: Algoverse AI
bullets: **Co-first author** of a paper accepted to **NeurIPS 2025** Mechanistic Interpretability (**MechInterp**) and New Perspectives in Graph ML (**NPGML**) Workshops.
Designed a novel Hybrid Attribution and Pruning (HAP) framework that combines attribution patching with edge pruning to discover faithful LLM circuits **46% faster** than state-of-the-art methods.

Implemented attribution scoring, pruning optimization, and evaluation pipelines in **PyTorch/TensorFlow**; used GPT-2 Small as a baseline model, with experiments run on NVIDIA H100 clusters (hosted on **Runpod**).

projects.name: LoSeR: Decomposable High-Frequency Trading Architecture
bullets: Architected a novel hybrid framework (**LoSeR**) that decomposes time-series into linear and spectral trends, using **Statistical Recurrent Units** to model residuals and outperform **LSTMs** in capturing long-range dependencies.

Engineered a multi-horizon forecasting engine (predicting 1, 10, 30, 60-minute intervals) that implements dynamic uncertainty-based thresholding (RMSE scaling) to optimize trade execution, demonstrating profitable generalization on high-volatility S&P 500 data.

projects.name: Mechanistic Origins of Personalization Bias
bullets: Engineered a mechanistic interpretability pipeline in **PyTorch/TensorFlow** for **Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct**, processing **12,600+** inference rollouts to isolate layer-specific activation patterns and extract steering vectors.
Developed a **bias mitigation strategy**, synthesizing a mean-pooled Universal Vector to perform **surgical activation clamping**, which reduced personalization bias scores from ~88% to <1%.

Validated model performance on the **MMLU benchmark**, proving that **inference-time intervention** neutralized demographic biases without degrading general reasoning capabilities or requiring expensive retraining.
